A-I1.quote: This work describes the key elements in a Smart Metering system and compiles the most employed technologies and standards as well as their main features.

A-I2.quote: State of the Art and Trends Review of Smart Metering in Electricity Grids

A-I3.quote: Also data protection and security issues must be addressed. Not all technologies offer the same security levels and this needs to be faced.

A-I4.quote: Received: 29 October 2015; Accepted: 22 January 2016; Published: 29 February 2016

parsed.rationale: This is a peer-reviewed review in Applied Sciences (2016) whose principal subject is smart metering, so A-I1, A-I2, A-I4 and A-I5 are met. Privacy is not a stated aim and has no dedicated section. It appears only in passing: a 'Security & privacy' and 'Access to personal data' entry in a planning-considerations table that does not compare studies, and a few sentences in the challenges section. A-I3 is therefore not met (A-E6). Parts of the extracted text are garbled by overlapping characters (pages 2, 6, 10–14), but the readable text is enough to judge every criterion.
